mission_09: Email validation and cleaning combines regex pattern matching with string manipulation to ensure email addresses conform to standard formats. A valid email follows the pattern: local-part@domain.tld, where the local part can contain alphanumeric characters, dots, underscores, percent signs, plus signs, and hyphens. The domain must have at least one dot followed by a valid top-level domain. Real-world email data often contains leading/trailing whitespace, mixed case, multiple addresses separated by semicolons, or completely invalid entries. Using re.match() with a well-crafted regex pattern allows you to validate and extract valid emails from messy data.
